name: The Jasperlode Mine
summary: Kobolds have overrun the Jasperlode Mine in eastern Elwynn. Marshal Dughan sends scouts to learn how far the infestation has spread.

sections.title: A Second Incursion
sections.body: After kobolds swarmed the Fargodeep tunnels south of Goldshire, Marshal Dughan feared they had reached other mines. Jasperlode lies in the rocky foothills northeast of the Tower of Azora and supplies raw stone and metal to the kingdom. Dughan cannot spare Stormwind guards from their town patrols, so he sends independent adventurers east to see whether kobolds have taken this mine too.

sections.title: Overextended Defenses
sections.body: Scouts who reach Jasperlode's chambers find kobolds have driven out the human miners and fortified the dark passages. Marshal Dughan faces another blow as the crisis grows. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and royal troops are withheld from outlying territories. The local garrison has too few soldiers to clear the mines, leaving the kingdom's heart short of minerals and hemmed in by threats.

faq.q: Where is the Jasperlode Mine located?
faq.answer: Jasperlode Mine lies in the northern foothills of eastern Elwynn Forest. Travel east from Goldshire along the main road, pass the Tower of Azora, then head north into the hills.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Dughan need a scout instead of sending guards?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan has too few guards to spare. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and political gridlock in the capital has left local forces stretched thin protecting farms and towns from bandits and gnolls, so Dughan relies on civilian scouts.

faq.q: Why are kobolds taking over Elwynn's mines?
faq.answer: Kobolds tunnel toward mineral veins and damp caves. As Stormwind's military presence thinned, they grew bolder and pushed into human mines like Fargodeep and Jasperlode to claim gold, ore, and territory.

faq.q: What happens after scouting the Jasperlode Mine?
faq.answer: After you report Jasperlode's fall, Marshal Dughan faces the loss of mines in the east and threats on several fronts. He turns his attention to western Elwynn, where Riverpaw gnolls are putting heavy pressure on the Westbrook Garrison.

faq.q: Why is the loss of Jasperlode Mine significant to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Elwynn's mines supply the ore and stone Stormwind needs for its economy and to forge weapons and armor. Losing Fargodeep and Jasperlode halts mineral extraction and weakens the kingdom's recovery.

faq.q: Who owns the Tower of Azora nearby?
faq.answer: The Tower of Azora is a small mage tower along Elwynn Forest's eastern road. Theocritus, the Archmage of Azora, presides there, and Azora's servants run the tower. Travelers use it as a landmark on the way to the eastern foothills.

angles.text: As a miner, you see valuable deposits in Jasperlode's tunnels, but territorial kobolds stand between you and the ore.
As an Alliance member, you see how fragile Stormwind's home territories have become without centralized royal support, with both Fargodeep and Jasperlode lost.
As a human, you witness Elwynn's rural infrastructure faltering as frontier resources fall close to the capital.
